bugs.summary: SaveUploadedFile now calls os.Chmod on the destination directory every time, even when it already existed. Chmod on a directory the process does not own (e.g. /tmp) fails with 'operation not permitted', so uploads into such directories now return an error; on directories it does own, it silently changes their permissions to 0750 (or the given perm). Before this change only os.MkdirAll was called, which leaves existing directories alone.
bugs.trigger: c.SaveUploadedFile(file, "/tmp/upload.txt") as a non-root user: os.Chmod("/tmp", 0750) fails with EPERM and the upload errors (issue #4622). Saving into an existing user-owned dir with mode 0755 changes it to 0750. The fix (#4702) stats the directory before MkdirAll and only chmods a directory it just created; its test asserts a pre-existing directory's mode is unchanged.

related_valid: os.Chmod only applies the mode to the last directory; parent directories created by MkdirAll keep the umask-reduced mode, so the requested perm is not enforced on the whole path.
The variadic perm parameter silently ignores every value after the first.
